newsitem.title: USA: Borg-Warner wins $50 mln security contract.
newsitem.headline: Borg-Warner wins $50 mln security contract.

text.p: Borg-Warner Protective Services, a unit of Borg-Warner Security Corp, said Wednesday it won a $50 million contract from DynMcDermott Petroleum Operations Co to provide security and related services at five sites in Louisiana and Texas.
The contract is for three years with two option years, the company said.
DynMcDermott is the U.S. Department of Energy's prime contractor to manage and operate the Strategic Petroleum Reserve Project, Borg-Warner said.
